purpose: Revised visual material calibration search space for QC7-5244 black plastic after human review found v1 too dark, too uniform, and too matte/CGI-like.
diagnosis_from_v1: The v1 best candidate had a high single-ROI score but did not match whole-image material appearance.
Human review described the real part as deep cool gray plastic with subtle molded texture and soft broad highlights.
The synthetic result looked too dark, too neutral, too uniform, and too matte.
This V2 space shifts base color brighter and cooler, increases possible specular response, and keeps subtle noise/bump available.
notes: This search space is still visual calibration only, not physical BRDF recovery.
Only parameters currently consumed by render_candidate.py are listed as active parameters.
Defect parameters are excluded from this fitting stage.
Use multi-ROI audit outputs to judge candidates; do not accept a material from the weighted score alone.

recommended_scoring.roi_requirement: Use multiple manually reviewed clean plastic ROIs: center flat, edge highlight, inner shadow transition, and micro-texture band.
recommended_scoring.post_fit_audit: Run tools/audit_material_fit_multiroi.py and review the contact sheet before setting this material as a generation default.

planned_future_parameters_not_active_yet.roughness_noise_strength: Requires render_candidate.py node support before use.
planned_future_parameters_not_active_yet.micro_bump_scale: Current renderer uses noise_scale and bump_strength only.
planned_future_parameters_not_active_yet.camera_noise_strength: Should be handled as camera/postprocess calibration, not base material.
